verdict.rationale: The open guidance confirms that 'firms that represent employers' can manage 'many tasks' in eServices, so a third-party representative model exists. However, the pack never publishes what those representatives may or may not do, and the authenticated portal (EAMS/SAW) that may hold the details could not be inspected. missing for 10: published third-party authorization/power-of-attorney forms, defined representative roles and permission scopes, an explicit list of actions or signatures reserved to the employer personally, independent or hands-on corroboration.
